B6.3.6 mandates at least 2 different dry-weather specifications (min_distinct_dry_compounds = 2, implying min_pit_stops = 1 in a dry race). Art. B6.2.4 Table specifies Alternative Format (Sprint) allocation of 12 dry sets: 2 Hard, 4 Medium, 6 Soft (corroborated by Formula1.com 01 July 2026 tyre allocation article). max_pit_stops = 4 and min_stint_length_laps = 1 are declared simulator search bounds.
